page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; a single text column with a heading and paragraphs; short marginal notes in the right margin beside the first two paragraphs. The left edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Explic. 1.
main_text.p: Scythæ varia regna habueruntVaria Scytharum regna fuerunt: Præcipua autem Getarum, Tauricanorum, Amazonum, Sacarum, Massagetarum vel Neurorum, Agathyrsorum, Gelonorum, Budinorum, Sarmatarum & Celtarum: Sed hæc omnia parum nobis cognita sunt. Celeberrimi inter Scythas fuere Europæi ad Danubium atq; Tanaim, & Asiatici sive Massagetæ, quorum Regina fuit Tomyris, quæ Cyrum in prælio obtruncavit.
main_text.head: Explic. 2.
main_text.p: Inter omnes autem Scytharum Universam penè Asiam sibi subjeceruntres antiquas memorabilis imprimis est ipsorum expeditio Asiatica, quâ Rege Madye sive Indathyrso ingenti cum exercitu universam penè Asiam, usq; ad Ægyptum, Imperio suo subjecerunt, & per 28. annos obtinuerunt; de quo Herodotus lib. 1. & 4.

page.notes: Right margin notes read as "Scythæ / varia re- / gna ha- / buerunt" and "Univer- / sam penè Asiā / sibi subjece- / runt"; the second note is shown here in full as one note beside the second paragraph. The Greek-free text has no doubtful readings except: "Massa-getarum" at a line end is printed with a dot or hyphen after "Maffa" and is transcribed with the hyphen [?]; "Tauricanorum" is printed as "Taurica-" / "norum" and is joined with its hyphen. The catchword "Ex-" and signature "A 6" are at the foot right. The heads "Explic. 1." and "Explic. 2." are set as small centred lines and are given level 2. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
